D1_globe_lynn.what: Land-only globe turns from the Atlantic to New England; a reticle marker and callout land on LYNN, USA at "Lynn". At "about thirteen thousand kilometres" an amber great-circle arc (with a dashed ground track) draws to BENGALURU while the camera travels with it and the distance counter rides the arc to ~13,000 KM (OUR CALCULATION). India's coast warms amber when the arc lands.
D1_globe_lynn.notes:
- Distance check: Lynn (42.47 N, 70.95 W) to Bengaluru (12.97 N, 77.59 E) great circle = 13,065 km, shown as ~13,000.
- The spec's corner tag (OUR CALCULATION) is also kept small under the counter because it is part of the on-screen line.

D2_squadrons.what: 42 delta-fighter slots (7 × 6) draw in on a drafting grid while SANCTIONED counts to 42 on "forty two". On "twenty nine" 29 slots fill amber one by one (the ACTUAL counter follows the fills to ~29); the 13 empty slots turn red and pulse.
D2_squadrons.notes: - Generic delta silhouette (not a manufacturer drawing).

D3_orders.what: Order stamps 2021 and 2025 drop in with a damped bounce; each counts up as its jets land in the 20 × 9 rack (83 amber, then 97 ceramic white), landing on "eighty three" and "ninety seven". The lower-left line builds 83 → 83 + 97 → 83 + 97 = 180 JETS.

D4_promise.what: Engraved timeline 2021–2026 (month ticks). The amber PROMISED 2023 pin drops on "twenty twenty three"; the delivery pin then slides month by month (its chip reads the month as it moves) to MAR 2025 while the gap fills red, ending on FIRST ENGINE MAR 2025.
D4_promise.notes: - The spec's one-line text is split onto the two pins (PROMISED 2023 · FIRST ENGINE MAR 2025).

D5_engines_jets.what: 99 generic engine icons (11 × 9); on "fourteen" 14 light amber (ENGINES SENT counts to 14 OF 99), every slot flashes on "ninety nine". On "thirty jets" 29 grey jets appear on the right (JETS BUILT: 29) and breathe while they wait.

D6_bomb_space.what: Land-only globe. Big 9 / NUCLEAR-ARMED STATES with nine red reticle pulses at the nine states (abstract: no labels, no borders); on "About ten" the counter turns to ~10 / OWN ROCKET TO ORBIT and ten orbits draw around the globe, each with its satellite.
D6_bomb_space.params: `nuclear` (n, label, pulse positions), `orbit` (n, label, count), beat times `t`.
D6_bomb_space.notes: - Pulse positions are the nine nuclear-armed states in SIPRI's count; the orbits are illustrative (no countries named).

D7_engine_club.what: Title THE ENGINE CLUB (lower left). A polar-tilted view over the North Atlantic holds USA, Russia, Britain and France; each reticle marker and its makers' callout lands as the VO names it. The camera then swings east for CHINA (AECC); India's coast warms faint amber with a hollow, dashed reticle: in view, but empty.
D7_engine_club.notes:
- Markers sit near each maker's home region (GE/P&W north-east US, UEC Saturn/Klimov west Russia, Rolls-Royce Derby, Safran Paris, AECC Beijing).
- "India outlined" is done with its coastline and a soft tint, never a land-border outline (a land border is a political border).

D8_russia_route.what: Close on south India: BENGALURU marker; a generic altitude test chamber icon appears and is struck through in red with NO HIGH-ALTITUDE TEST FACILITY. On J039 the camera pulls back and an amber arc carries a small crate from Bengaluru to the Moscow region, landing on CIAM · GROMOV, ZHUKOVSKY; lower-left BENGALURU → RUSSIA.

D9_weight.what: Precision dial 900–1,400 kg (10 kg ticks). The needle swings with inertia to 1,100 on "eleven hundred kilos" (amber target mark, 1,100 KG TARGET), then on "twelve hundred and thirty five" overshoots and settles on 1,235 while the overweight band glows red (1,235 KG ACTUAL). Live readout under the hub.

D10_thrust.what: Thrust bar 0–90 kN. The dashed 81 kN line rises on "eighty one" (81 kN TARGET); on "it reached only about seventy" the fill climbs, stalls at ~70 with a dying shudder, and the gap to 81 hatches red (~70 kN REPORTED).
D10_thrust.notes: - Same thrust-bar motif as the film's other target/achieved scenes (target line vs fill).

D11_years.what: Mechanical split-flap calendar flips 1996 → 2008 (one year per flap, top flap falls then bottom flap) under a warm work light, with dust motes drifting through the beam.

D12_cost.what: Two bars on a ₹ crore scale. The COST ESTIMATE bar opens at ₹382 CR; SPENT grows to ₹1,996 CR on "two thousand crore ... spent" (chip ₹1,996 CR SPENT BY 2012); then the estimate bar and big counter climb to ₹2,839 CR on "twenty eight hundred crore", a dashed mark keeping the old ₹382 point; lower-left ₹382 CR → ₹2,839 CR.
D12_cost.notes: - ₹ comes from the latin-ext Inter face declared in index.html.

D13_hours.what: Left: a stopwatch (ROCKET: MINUTES) sweeps once and stops with a recoil. Right: a four-drum odometer (JET ENGINE: THOUSANDS OF HOURS) rolls to 4,000 and a + stamps in.
D13_hours.notes: - The rocket side shows no number (spec gives none).

D14_paris_derby.what: J080: SAFRAN marker in Paris, amber arc to Bengaluru (GTRE), lower-left SAFRAN + GTRE · SELECTED AUG 2025. J081: camera pushes in on India, its coast warms and FULL INDIAN IP stamps down. J082: chip AWAITING FINAL APPROVAL · OCT 2026 (pulsing pending dot) while the Safran arc turns dashed; then a second, ceramic-amber arc from Derby (ROLLS-ROYCE + RELIANCE, AUG 2026) to a hollow India marker.
D14_paris_derby.notes: - The Derby arc ends at central India (no city named, since the spec says only "India").

D15_china.what: A J-20 photo slot with a slow push-in; years axis without dates whose ticks stream past during "decades, and many failures"; chips light in turn RUSSIAN AL-31F → CHINESE WS-10C → WS-15 (earlier ones dim), with J-20: top left.
D15_china.params: `photo` (path of the J-20 photo; empty renders the neutral slate PHOTO SLOT plate), `focus` (push-in target, 0..1), `lead`, `chips`, beat times `t`.
D15_china.notes: - **Photo slot:** put the licensed J-20 photo in this folder (for example `assets/j20.jpg`), set `photo: "assets/j20.jpg"` in `params.js`, log it in the media manifest, re-render. It loads through Three's loading manager, so HyperFrames waits for it; it is cover-fitted with a dark lower scrim for the chips.
